## Train - test splitting


## Torch import

```{r prados_delayed_ds}

delayed_ds <- dataset(
  name = "sce_dataset",
 
  initialize = function(x,y) {
    self$x <- x;self$y <- y
    stopifnot(identical(length(y),nrow(x)))
  },
 
  .length = function() {length(self$y)},
 
  .getbatch = function(index) { list(
    x = torch_tensor(as.matrix(self$x[index, ,drop=FALSE]), torch_float()),
    y = torch_tensor(as.matrix(self$y[index], ncol=1), torch_long())
  )},
 
  .getitem = function(index) {
    if (is.list(index)) {index <- unlist(index)}
    self$.getbatch(index)
  }
)
```


```{r}
train <- readRDS("data/train_50p.rds")
test <- readRDS("data/test_50p.rds")
```


```{r}
train_ds <- delayed_ds(x=t(logcounts(train)), y=as.integer(train$BraakStage))
```


```{r}
test_ds <- delayed_ds(t(logcounts(test)), as.integer(test$BraakStage))
```



## Cost matrix


```{r}
scaling_factor <- function(ranks){
  m_2 <- length(ranks)**2 
  m_sum <- sum(table(ranks)**2)
  (m_2-m_sum)*0.5
}

sf <- scaling_factor(train_ds$y)
```



```{r}
c <- torch_tensor(matrix(c(0,2,6, 2,0,4, 6,4,0), nrow = 3, ncol = 3,
       dimnames = list(c("1", "2", "3"),
                       c("1", "2", "3"))), dtype = torch_long(), device = "cuda")
c <- c/sf
```





# Model



```{r}
ordinal_classifier <- nn_module(
  "ordinal_classifier",
  initialize = function(class_names){
    #browser()
    # self$feature_names
    self$layers <- nn_sequential(
      nn_dropout(),
      nn_linear(in_features = 33694L, out_features = 3072L), nn_tanh(), 
      nn_linear(in_features = 3072L, out_features = 2048L), nn_relu(),
      nn_linear(in_features = 2048L, out_features = 1024L), nn_relu(),
      nn_linear(in_features = 1024L, out_features = 1L)
    ) 
  },
  
  forward = function(x){
    x |> self$layers()
  }
)
```



```{r}
#torch_set_default_dtype(torch_float())
fitted <- ordinal_classifier |>
  setup(loss = nn_ordinal_regression_loss(c=c),
        optimizer = optim_adam) |>
  set_opt_hparams(weight_decay=.7) |>
  fit(train_ds,
      epochs=10L,
      dataloader_options=list(batch_size=100L),
      valid_data=test_ds, verbose=TRUE,
      #, accelerator=accelerator(cpu = TRUE)
      # ,
      callbacks=list(luz_callback_early_stopping(monitor="valid_loss", mode = "min", patience = 2))
      )
```


```{r}
luz_save(fitted, "models/model_OR_best_valid_loss.luz")
#fitted <- luz_load("models/model_OR_best_valid_loss.luz")
```



```{r}
plot(fitted)
```


```{r}
model <- ordinal_classifier |> setup(loss = nn_ordinal_regression_loss(c=c), optimizer = optim_adam)
rates_and_losses <- model |> lr_finder(train_ds)

rates_and_losses |> plot()
```



```{r}
y_hat <- predict(fitted, test_ds)

boxplot(as_array(y_hat$to(device="cpu")) ~ test_ds$y)
```
